# Extract and explore deviation scores

## 1. Data and libraries

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)
library(corrplot)
library(BBmisc)
library(lmerTest)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(ggpubr)
library(cluster)
library(stringr)
library(factoextra)
library(broom)
library(readxl)
library(performance)
library(emmeans)
library(influence.ME)
library(rstatix)
library(ggdist)
library(ggpattern)
```

```{r}
global <- read.csv("Output/global_deviation_scores.csv")
```

```{r}
global <- global[,c("SubjectID","AverageDS")]
```

Cognitive and behavioral data:

```{r}
IQ <- read.csv("/Users/robcolaes/Desktop/PhD/2_CIP/Analyses/3_NormativeModelling/4_Characteristics/Output/list_IQ.csv")
IQ <- IQ[,c("ID","Total_IQ","VCI","PSI")]

BRIEF <- read.csv("/Users/robcolaes/Desktop/PhD/2_CIP/Analyses/3_NormativeModelling/4_Characteristics/Output/list_BRIEF.csv")
BRIEF <- BRIEF[,c("ID","Behavioral_regulation_Tscore","Metacognition_Tscore", "Global_executive_composite_Tscore")]

CBCL <- read.csv("/Users/robcolaes/Desktop/PhD/2_CIP/Analyses/3_NormativeModelling/4_Characteristics/Output/list_CBCL.csv")
```

```{r}
FINAL <- merge(global,IQ,by.x="SubjectID",by.y="ID")
FINAL <- merge(FINAL,BRIEF,by.x="SubjectID",by.y="ID")
FINAL <- merge(FINAL,CBCL,by.x="SubjectID",by.y="ID")
```

```{r}
FINAL$Group <- as.factor(FINAL$Group)
```

## 2. WATERFALL PLOTS

### 2.1. WISC

```{r}
FSIQ_plot <- ggplot(FINAL, aes(x = Group, y = Total_IQ, fill = Group)) +
  # clinical threshold band + line
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 50, ymax = 85,
           fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.20) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 85, color = "black", linewidth = 1) +

  # violin (distribution shape)
  geom_violin(width = 0.8, alpha = 0.5, colour = NA, trim = FALSE) +

  # boxplot (summary stats)
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, colour = "black", alpha = 0.8) +

  # individual points, jittered
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.6, shape = 21,
              colour = "black", stroke = 0.2) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("H" = "#a2c8e1", "C" = "#05326c")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(50, 155)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("C", "H"), labels = c("H" = "Control", "C" = "Study")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "FSIQ", fill = "Group") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black")
  )
FSIQ_plot
```
